teach.text: An instruction tells you what to do. Do one step, then the next. Keep the steps in order: first, then, last. Do not skip a step, or the task may go wrong. You can give instructions too. Make each one clear. Say just what to do. "Hop three times" is clear. "Move a bit" is not clear.
examples: Clear: Clap two times. Not clear: Do something.
Open the door, then walk out. Skip the first step and you bump the door!
teach.reteach: Say each step out loud before you do it. When you give a step, say just what to do.
